answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable bond that only unlocks after a long history of honest trades, like a falcon proving itself flight after flight along a ridge before it earns a pearl of trust. A newcomer with no stake can transact only in tiny amounts, while a fake army of a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds and wait out the same aging period, so forging scale costs real capital and time instead of free copies.
